gitCommit.subject: Console: subscription messages, grace decisions and free trials claimed; a business's grace and messages
gitCommit.body:
Console: subscription messages, grace decisions and free trials claimed; a business's grace and messages

Three console pages over the API's oversight reads (0099; docs/101 §7), reads only:

- Messages — every subscription message across businesses, newest first: which message, for which business, by
  which channel to which masked destination, what became of it (in colour and words) and the recorded reason; every
  state counted; narrowed by state and by message.
- Grace — each paid period end's decision, granted or none available, with the period and grace ends in the
  business's zone, what was used before it and what recorded it; how many run now and how many businesses are at
  the limit of three in 12 months.
- Free trials — each claim and its exact end in the business's zone, running or ended, the terms version, and the
  eligible businesses that have not claimed.

A business's page adds its grace (running, its end and hours left, the allowance used, when the next returns,
whether the next period end would open one) and its messages (the next due, the latest fifty). The message naming
and state badge are shared with the portal. EN/FR/AR; component and browser tests.
